newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 10.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Jan 10.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Friday:
* Indonesia plans to broaden its customs facilities for imported products which will be used to boost exports, a senior government official said.

* The Dow index jumped 76.19 points to 6,625.67 on Thursday as stocks got a boost from the government's December Producer Price Index (PPI), which confirmed that U.S. inflation remained in check at the wholesale level.
* The Jakarta Composite Index fell 4.77 points, or 0.72 percent, to close at 657.43 points on Thursday following profit taking in certain heavyweight and some banking stocks.
* On Friday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,363.25/63.60 in early trading against the opening of 2,363.00/64.00.
* Telkom following reports it planned to launch several new business services in the middle of 1997.
* Mining firm Alter Abadi following its debut on Thursday.
* Fishing firm Daya Guna Samudera on expected higher demand from its main market Japan following reports of the oil tanker disaster there polluting fisheries areas.
* Cement firms Indocement, Semen Cibinong and Semen Gresik on a government announcement it would grant export licences to five cement manufacturers.
* Bank NISP on reports of a plan to launch a joint venture bank with Oversea-Chinese Banking Corp Ltd of Singapore this month.
* Steady Safe on reports that a subsidiary has launched a ferry service plying the busy strait between Java and Sumatra islands.
